ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Clause 9.2.2: the audit programme takes into consideration the importance of the processes concerned and the results of previous audits.

The internal audit programme of the Manila ISMS (LI-AUD, 20 December 2026) covers A.8.32 Change management, but no internal audit held before Stage 1 did: the January 2027 audits took the clauses first and leave the change process to a later round. Every production change to the customer portal passes through that process, LI-SOA (as updated in week 12) marks A.8.32 applicable and partially implemented, and the office's own change test, CHG-TEST of December 2026, found it not effective (6 deviations in 25 changes).
LI-AUD, sheet Programme; LI-SOA, row A.8.32; CHG-TEST, conclusion
The Information Security Auditor said the rounds were put in order clause by clause and then sprint by sprint, and the change test's result was not looked at when the January round was chosen.
cert: The ISMS scope (LI-SCOPE), the information security policy and the risk assessment and treatment method are reviewed as documents.
The Statement of Applicability (LI-SOA) and the risk treatment plan (LI-RTP) are reviewed, with whether the office is ready for the next stage.
The auditor checks that internal audits and management reviews are planned and performed at the Manila office (LI-AUD, LI-MR).
The auditor interviews staff on the Manila floor and samples records of the Statement of Applicability's controls in operation.
Findings are graded major or minor nonconformities, and the lead auditor recommends whether to certify.
No later than 12 months after the certification decision, an audit checks part of the ISMS and how earlier nonconformities were closed.
In the third year, another audit of part of the ISMS, with the internal audits, management reviews and complaints since the last one.
Before the certificate expires at the end of year three, an audit of the whole ISMS starts a new three-year cycle.
